item.title: Could 2026 be the worst year for snowpack in Oregon's recorded history?
item.description: NOAA is warning that Oregon's lack of snowpack could lead to dangerous conditions once summer arrives, with the Mt. Hood area experiencing one of the top three least snowy winters since records started in 1980.
